issues.detail: The Greek 'εντυγχανει' (entychanei) means 'to intercede' or 'to make requests,' but the Vietnamese 'cầu thay' combined with 'vì' (because) changes the logical relationship. The Greek 'οτι' (hoti) functions as a conjunction introducing the content of what the Spirit knows, not as a causal 'because'.
The Vietnamese translation omits the prepositional phrase 'κατα Θεον' (kata Theon), which specifies that the intercession is 'according to God'.
